jobs.description:
Patient Services Representative (4722C), University Health Services #90084 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
University Health Services (UHS) is a comprehensive college health service providing fully accredited, primary medical care, counseling and psychological services, and innovative health promotion programs for students, faculty, and staff. UHS provides on-campus medical care and coordinates supplemental needs for off-campus care through a network of community specialists and hospitals. UHS manages the student health insurance and workers' compensation insurance programs.
  
  
UHS provides services to students Monday through Friday from 8:00AM to 6:00PM and on weekends. Approximately 65,000 visits occur annually including Primary Care, Urgent Care, Occupational Health, and Specialty Clinics. Services are designed to enable students to get the most from their educational experience, minimizing the impact of illness, injury and emotional distress on their academic careers. Medical care and wellness programs for faculty and staff are designed to meet their occupational health needs and minimize lost work time. These visits all generate ancillary encounters with the Radiology, Clinical Laboratory, Physical Therapy and Pharmacy departments. The Counseling and Psychological Services department sees an additional 15,000 visits per year.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
A Patient Services Representative serves as the first point of contact for patients and clients, providing a welcoming and professional environment. The position manages patient registration, check-in and check-out processes, schedules appointments, verifies insurance information, and maintains accurate patient records. This role also coordinates communication between patients and healthcare providers, handles phone inquiries, and ensures efficient administrative operations. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and excellent customer service are essential to support a positive patient experience.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
**The First Review Date for this job is:** December 4, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Reception, Registration, Billing, and Cashiering - 50%
  
  
Promptly acknowledge and greet patients.
  
Provide HIPAA information.
  
Verify and update patient demographic information and insurance information.
  
Create appropriate cases and utilize account flags and folder notes as needed.
  
Update daily schedule to document appointment status, attended, no-shows and cancellations.
  
Verify patient contractual relationship, insurance eligibility and co-payment.
  
Collection of co-payments, including posting payments, providing receipt, and obtaining credit/debit card authorization when necessary.
  
Obtain financial documentation as required by the insurance carrier.
  
Explain terms and conditions of services and financial responsibility.
  
Maintain cashiering policies and procedures.
  
Prepare and route daily deposit, including balancing funds.
  
Provide limited or back up billing functions.
  
Enters charges into appropriate charge entry systems within established standards.
  
ICD-10 specificity, CPT and HCPCS codes and modifiers.
  
Consults with providers for clarification of clinical data when encountering conflicting or missing documentation.
  
Notifies appropriate UHS personnel regarding issues that prevent timely data entry.
  
May assist with insurance denial resolution, including department recirculating error file, and submitting corrections.
  
Maintains knowledge of health system and departmental related policies and procedures relating to coding practices as needed for assigned duties.
  
Supports EAP programs with payments, forms, and communication.
  
Accepts HOF payments and provides related advocacy and customer service.
  
Manages EMR activation and related communications.
  
  
Telephone Coordination - 10%
  
  
Answer multi-line telephone system.
  
Screen calls to determine nature and urgency of caller's needs.
  
Determine how best to handle, e.g., take necessary action, refer calls, transfer calls and take messages.
  
Messages must be complete and accurate and routed according to urgency.
  
Coordinate all incoming calls to assigned stations with providers and clinical teams.
  
Adherence to University and department standards for telephone customer service.
  
  
Scheduling - 10%
  
  
Prescreen patients by conducting concise, courteous and informed interviews: obtaining pertinent information to determine appropriateness for scheduling.
  
May complete pre-registration for scheduling purposes, including verification and updating of patient insurance and demographic information.

jobs.description:
Ally Care Team (ACT) Supervisor (6811U), University Health Services #90061 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
For over 100 years, UHS has been providing health care and integrative services for a wide range of physical and mental health care needs to the Berkeley campus community. And we've spent a quarter-century of that time at the Tang Center, a fully accredited health care facility, UHS employs over 300 people, including primary and urgent care physicians, psychiatrists, consulting medical specialists, nurse practitioners, registered nurses, pharmacists, health educators, social workers, and other health administrative professionals. All our clinicians, counselors, and nurses are state-licensed and/or certified in their respective fields. In addition to our staff, Berkeley students participate in UHS peer, intern, and volunteer programs. Together, we provide services on a continuum from prevention through treatment.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Under the direction of the Manager of Behavioral Health, the incumbent will provide direct supervision and clinical oversight of mobile crisis operations, performing a wide range of complex tasks with a high level of autonomy. Supervises licensed clinicians and training staff providing mobile crisis responses to the campus, including the University Village site. Supervises and evaluates the work of clinical and non-clinical team members, including staff student workers. Responsible for evaluating and ensuring the quality of Mobile Crisis services. Involves psychological evaluation, diagnosis, counseling, psychotherapy, and crisis intervention with individuals and groups across a broad spectrum of developmental and psychological concerns that interfere with effective academic and personal functioning. Develops psycho-educational programs. Also performs one or more of the following functions: Uses and interprets educational, vocational, and psychological tests; provides clinical supervision of professional graduate-level trainees. Must be licensed as a Psychologist, Social Worker, or Licensed Marriage and Family Counselor in California. Ensures provider adherence to professional standards, internal policies, and external regulations. Provides high-level consultation to staff, often regarding complex, high-risk issues. Participates in the development and maintenance of crisis services delivery policies and procedures, and offers relevant training for staff. Assists the Manager of Behavioral Health in the evaluation and improvement of clinical processes to ensure the quality of mobile crisis services delivery.
  
  
This position is a clinical-supervisory role. Approximately 50-60% of the work involves direct clinical care within an integrated behavioral health model spanning primary care, urgent care, and campus-based response. The remaining 40-50% includes clinical supervision of 4-6 Clinicians, workflow coordination, and cross-branch collaboration.
  
Care includes supporting immediate mental health needs across campus in collaboration with campus partners, including consultation and response support with UCPD, Residential Life, faculty and staff, Title IX, Path to Care, and other campus teams. The work can be time-sensitive and may not follow a predictable clinic schedule.
  
As a supervisor, you will coordinate clinician coverage across the Behavioral Health team and the Campus Response team, ensuring that daily staffing, field deployments, and consultation requests are managed effectively. You will provide direct consultations, and serve as a bridge between the clinical team and broader campus partners.
  
The day-to-day work is fast-paced and highly collaborative within campus and medical settings. Clinicians provide same-day behavioral health assessment, brief intervention, crisis support, and care coordination in close collaboration with medical providers. Warm handoffs, rapid transitions, and occasional session interruptions are core expectations. As supervisor, you will model this work while supporting your team in navigating it.
  
We recognize this is a unique role. We will provide training on the model, workflows, and coordination practices. If you bring strong clinical fundamentals, supervision experience, sound judgment, and interest in integrated campus-based work, we can support the learning curve.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is December 4, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.

Daily Operations & Program Management - 40%
  
  
Develops, implements, and manages a crisis mobile program serving all individuals in and around campus experiencing a mental health crisis.
  
Collaborates and accepts referrals from campus and community partners, law enforcement, and external sta

jobs.description:
Position: Case Manager, BRC

Location: Boccardo Reception Center, San Jose

Employment Type: Temporary (6 months Term) Full Time, Non-Exempt

Compensation: $30.96/Hourly

PROGRAM SUMMARY:

EMERGENCY (ER) SHELTER:

HomeFirst operates various Emergency Shelter sites throughout Santa Clara County, all shelters provide access to nightly accommodations, meals, showers, laundry, and other basic need services. Additional service onsite include access to 24/7 operations staff, workshops, linkage to clinical and local resource. All HomeFirst Shelter sites follow the principles of Harm Reduction and Housing First. HomeFirst staff adhere to the Santa Clara County Continuum of Care Quality Assurance Standards and offer support in completing intakes and assessments for linkage to Coordinated Entry.

**Services include:**

* Homelessness prevention
* Emergency and cold-weather shelters
* Comprehensive Veterans’ services
* Rapid Re-Housing programs
* Bridge Housing Communities
* Emergency Interim Housing
* Affordable permanent housing
* Permanent Supportive Housing
* Street-based outreach

**Benefits of joining the HomeFirst Team:**

* Professional growth opportunities within the organization
* Access to our Emergency Assistance Program (EAP) services

**QUALITIES**:

The BRC Case Manager is passionate about serving others and sees themself in a helping profession long term. They are pro-active and responsive to the needs of our participants, meeting them “where they’re at” and bridging the gap between the individual and our services. They manage their time well and demonstrate strong organizational abilities. With the support of program leadership, the Case Manager participates in our culture of learning and increases their knowledge of evidence-based practices over the course of their employment. Together, we model the values and principles of HomeFirst within the agency and broader community.

HomeFirst is a diverse company in a diverse field, and the Case Manager seeks to work with people from a variety of social and economic backgrounds. They are a highly collaborative member of our participant services team and enjoy a team-oriented work environment.

**DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES**:

Direct Services (70%)

* Provide street and encampment-based case management to unhoused participants at targeted locations throughout the City of San Jose. Provide linkage and coordinate services to community resources, including health care and VHHP, Benefit application, employment counseling, family reunification, diversion, etc.
* Works collaboratively with Program Manager and maintains accurate records of services provided.
* Collaborates with community partners regarding support services for participants.
* Utilizes supervision appropriately, maintains open lines of communication, and provides updates on intake activity.
* Knows and implements agency and program policies and procedures.
* Properly reports any suspected cases of abuse.
* Maintains professional relations and conduct.
* Maintains thorough, accurate records of case management activities with every program participant, as required by grant contracts. Conducts client intake, including VISPDAT, as needed.
* Works with program participants to develop and implement an individual case management plan, individual needs assessments, housing action plan, and provide support to help them achieve their housing and personal goals. Meets regularly with program participants at a frequency determined by the participant's needs.
* Provides support services that employ a Critical Time Intervention (CTI) model—secure transportation of participants to shelter, critical appointments, and additional destinations.
* Weekend and after-hours support are required when requested by the participant or funder.
* Assist with other duties as assigned.

Documentation (20%)

* Documents, via progress notes in HMIS, all case management activity within two business days and maintains all other case file paperwork and documentation.
* Participates in ongoing analysis of and program alignment with industry best practices.
* Proactively and consistently improves the quality and effectiveness of program services.
* Conducts ongoing re-assessments of the client's needs and status and documents assessment in HMIS.

General (10%)

* Attends all meetings and training relevant to this position.
* Assist with office-related tasks as needed.
* Utilize supervision appropriately, maintain open lines of communication, and provide updates on activities regularly.
* Know and follow agency and program policies and procedures.
* Properly report any suspected cases of abuse. Other duties as assigned.

Skills, Abilities, and Knowledge:

* Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and be flexible with priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain priorities and meet established deadlines.
* Exceptional organizational skills
* Strong sense of accountability
* Ability to present oneself and the agency professionally to internal and external audiences.
* Ability to work as a member of a team,
* Ability to work with people of diverse socio-economic backgrounds.
* Ability to walk long distances on rough terrain (such as trails, creek sides, and high-traffic areas
* Preference for extensive fieldwork over office-based work Strong written and oral communication skills

Other:

* Able to perform sedentary work.
* Able to lift up to 30 lbs. on occasion.
* Ability to use a keyboard and read computer screens for extended periods.
* Able to stand/sit for extended periods, kneel, reach, and bend related to the completion of duties.

jobs.title: Bilingual Case Manager-BRC
jobs.description:
Position: Case Manager, BRC (Bilingual)

Location: Boccardo Reception Center (2011 Little Orchard Street, San Jose, Ca)

Employment Type: Regular Full Time, Non-Exempt

Compensation: $32.20/Hourly

**ABOUT HOMEFIRST**

Established in 1980, HomeFirst™ is a nonprofit organization passionately working to end homelessness. We serve the Bay Area community through low-barrier programming and systems leadership – meeting each person where they are by offering support and resources that address immediate and long-term housing needs. With nearly 45 years of experience, we view housing as a fundamental human right and understand that solving homelessness requires a collaborative effort.

**OUR VALUES**

* Kindness: We act with empathy toward others.
* Passion: We ignite change to fulfill our mission.
* Excellence: We deliver exceptional service to our communities.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The goal of HomeFirst’s case management services at the Boccardo Reception center is to provide access to resources and housing for homeless individuals in Santa Clara County, (San Jose) California. The case management services will achieve this goal by providing participants with comprehensive supportive services to help link them to a network of community resources such as: psychiatric, medical, employment, housing, income, Housing Problem Solving (HPS), family reunification, and other services with permanent housing as the goal.

**QUALITIES**:

The Case Manager is passionate about serving others and sees themself in a helping profession long term. They are pro-active and responsive to the needs of our participants, meeting them “where they’re at” and bridging the gap between the individual and our services.

They manage their time well and demonstrate strong organizational abilities. With the support of program leadership, the Case Manager participates in our culture of learning and increases their knowledge of evidence-based practices over the course of their employment. Together, we model the values and principles of HomeFirst within the agency and broader community.

HomeFirst is a diverse company in a diverse field, and the Case Manager seeks to work with people from a variety of social and economic backgrounds. They are a highly collaborative member of our participant services team and enjoy a team-oriented work environment.

**REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS**

This role reports to the Program Manager.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Maintain a case load as a case manager of homeless individuals in Santa Clara County by providing direct case management to program participants.
* Provide excellent customer service to those referred, welcoming them to the shelter and providing a tour of the BRC facility and amenities
* Provide community-based case management services to program participants
* Conduct participant intakes per HomeFirst requirements, including assessments - needs assessment, housing support, services plans, and Biopsychosocial
* Link participants to Santa Clara County Coordinated Entry System via completion of Vulnerability Index & Service Prioritization and Decision-Making Tool (VI-SPDAT)
* Educate participants on HMIS client portal features and enrollment
* Provide appropriate referrals and linkage to community services, including mainstream benefits and access to medical and behavioral services
* Conduct ongoing reassessments of the participants’ needs and initiate referrals to appropriate BRC programs
* Manage bed list and waitlists, to ensure program maintains capacity (DTHBP)
* Works with program participants to develop and implement an individual case management and housing plan, and provide support to help them achieve their housing goals
* Work collaboratively with other team members as applicable to communicate interventions with the participant
* Collaborate with community partners regarding support services for clients
* Engage in case conferencing with a multi-disciplinary team approach
* Utilize supervision appropriately, maintaining open lines of communication and providing updates on intake status
* Know and implement agency and program policies and procedures
* Properly report any suspected cases of abuse
* Maintain professional relations and conduct
* Maintain thorough, accurate records of case management activities with every program participant, in the HMIS system
* Meets regularly with program participants at a frequency determined by their needs
* Assist participants with transportation needs to critical appointments
* Support participants in becoming document ready for benefits and housing applications
* Documents, via progress notes in HMIS, all case management activity within 3 business days and maintains all other case file paperwork and documentation
* Attend all meetings and trainings relevant to this position
* Assist with other duties assigned

**BENEFITS**

HomeFirst provides comprehensive benefits, including 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage and additional wellness options like chiropractic care, mental health support, pet insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program. We offer a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous matching, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits, and workers’ compensation. Employees enjoy 12 holidays, sick leave, and PTO starting at 15 days annually, increasing with tenure, plus 8 hours of civic engagement leave annually to volunteer.

**ORGANIZATIONAL EQUITY STATEMENT**

At HomeFirst, diversity, equity, and inclusion guide our services, workplace, and decisions. Recognizing housing as a social justice issue, we prioritize equitable practices, honor lived experiences and uphold dignity for all. By fostering belonging, accountability, and continuous improvement, we embed DEI values in our processes, recruitment, and leadership, striving for excellence at every level.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Cloud Partners
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Enterprises and developers reach Claude through the clouds they already run on: AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft. The cloud partner marketing team works with all three partners to put Claude in front of the people who build with it and the leaders who buy it.

As Program Manager, Cloud Partners, you'll own the programs and campaigns that run across those partnerships: technical webinars, hands-on developer workshops, and digital campaigns. You'll set the program strategy and calendar, decide which formats we invest in, and build each one so it can run on every cloud and in every region. You'll report to the leader of cloud partner marketing and work alongside the marketing leads for each cloud. They own the partner relationships and joint plans, and you'll own the scalable programs that deliver against them.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with wide scope. You'll design new programs and run them yourself, then direct agencies, regional teams, and partners to scale what works. You'll be measured on the pipeline your programs generate and influence, and on how deeply they reach target accounts and technical audiences.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the strategy and calendar for cross-cloud programs, planned with the marketing lead for each cloud and tied to target accounts and pipeline goals
* Lead the technical webinar programs we run with cloud partners, from topic and speaker strategy through promotion, regional and on-demand versions, and follow-up
* Build a repeatable developer workshop model and scale it across cities and regions with cloud partners, systems integrators, and Anthropic's technical teams
* Lead digital campaigns, including audience strategy, creative briefs, budget pacing, and optimization
* Own the budget for your programs and recommend how market development funds (MDF) are invested across them
* Direct agencies and vendors end to end, including scoping, briefs, quality, and spend
* Set the goals for each program before it launches, report on pipeline and account reach, and recommend what to scale, change, or stop
* Build the follow-up motion so program leads turn into opportunities and pipeline
* Work directly with program and marketing counterparts at cloud partners, balancing their goals with Anthropic's priorities
* Turn what works into playbooks and self-serve tools that regional and partner teams can run, using Claude to speed up repeatable work

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Have owned B2B marketing programs end to end across several channels, including webinars, in-person events or workshops, and paid digital campaigns
* Have run co-marketing programs with a cloud provider or a comparable technology partner, including joint planning and multi-party approvals
* Have managed program budgets, agencies or vendors, and partner funding such as MDF
* Can build, track, and report on campaigns in a CRM and a marketing automation platform
* Can analyze registration, attendance, budget, and pipeline data in spreadsheets or a reporting tool, and turn it into a clear recommendation
* Have planned and optimized paid campaigns on LinkedIn or a comparable platform, with an agency or an internal growth team
* Have led programs across sales, product, technical, and partner teams you did not manage
* Write clearly and precisely for executives, partners, and technical audiences
* Can run several programs at once without dropping quality, in an environment where priorities and dates change
* Care about the societal impacts of AI and are excited about helping organizations adopt AI responsibly

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Have worked in marketing at a major cloud provider, or have marketed a product through one
* Have marketed to developers and IT decision-makers as well as business leaders
* Have built a program model from scratch and scaled it through agencies, partners, or regional teams
* Have run programs across North America, EMEA, and APAC
* Have built account-based programs with sales teams against a named account list
* Understand cloud marketplaces, co-sell, and consumption-based business models
* Have marketed AI, data, or developer products
* Have used Claude or other AI tools to scale your own marketing work

**Role-specific policy:** For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or Seattle office at least 2 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. If based in Seattle, this role will require traveling to the San Francisco office once a month. Additionally, this role will also require travel up to 20% of the time for partner meetings and partner events.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

$255,000 - $320,000 USD

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

LiveX AI is looking for a proactive, technical Customer Success Manager to own the post-sales experience for our mid-market customers. You will be the day-to-day owner of a book of existing accounts, so that our Sales and Solution Engineering teams can focus on new and strategic accounts. Sales and Solution Engineering continue to own new customer acquisition and the relationship with strategic accounts, while you support strategic accounts with day-to-day work such as version updates, configuration, and account analysis. Depending on experience, you may also manage some of our larger accounts.

This is a technical, customer-facing role. You will own anything in a customer's account that does not require a code change: configuring and updating their AI agents, resolving support issues, and keeping their deployment on the latest version of our product. For your existing accounts, you will also be the first point of contact in customer meetings, collecting information and addressing concerns before bringing in Solution Engineering when needed.

Beyond keeping accounts stable and healthy, you will review each account every week to find ways to improve results and to spot upsell opportunities, and you will keep customers up to date on new LiveX AI offerings. When an opportunity comes up, you will help close it.

Years of experience matter less to us than technical ability and initiative. This role suits someone who is technically curious, takes ownership without being asked, and enjoys working directly with customers in a fast-paced startup.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Post-Sales Technical Support**

* Get involved with new accounts after launch, and take full ownership from Sales and Solution Engineering once the deployment is stable (typically 30+ days after onboarding) and the customer is happy.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for your assigned mid-market accounts after deployment.
* Provide high-quality technical support and own the resolution of any issue that does not require a code change, such as agent configuration, knowledge base updates, conversation flows, and troubleshooting.
* Escalate issues that require engineering work to Solution Engineering with clear context and reproduction steps, and follow them through to resolution.

**Customer Meetings**

* Lead regular meetings with your existing accounts as the first-line contact, gathering requirements, feedback, and technical details.
* Address customer questions and concerns directly where you can, and hand off to Solution Engineering with a clear summary when deeper technical work is needed.

**Product Updates & Service Quality**

* Keep every customer's AI agent up to date with the latest product version so customers always receive a high-quality service.
* Plan and communicate updates with customers, test changes before release, and confirm everything works as expected afterward.

**Account Analysis & Growth**

* Review each account weekly, using conversation data and usage metrics, to identify areas for improvement and upsell opportunities.
* Share findings and recommendations with customers and with the internal team.
* Keep customers informed about the latest LiveX AI offerings and features, and explore where they could add value for each account.
* Bring upsell and expansion opportunities to the Account Executive, who decides how each one is handled, and close deals yourself when the AE hands them to you.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required**

* 1+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as Customer Success, Technical Support, Implementation, Solutions Engineering, or Account Management. Recent graduates with strong technical skills and relevant internship experience are encouraged to apply.
* Strong technical aptitude: comfortable configuring software products, troubleshooting issues, and learning new technology quickly.
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including the confidence to lead parts of customer meetings.
* Analytical skills to review account data, spot trends, and turn them into concrete recommendations.
* A proactive work style: you take ownership, follow up without being reminded, and look for problems before customers report them.

**Preferred**

* Experience selling, upselling, or closing expansion deals.
* Experience with AI, conversational AI, or B2B SaaS products.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, or basic scripting.
* Familiarity with CRM tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Experience working in an early-stage startup.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Mid-market customers receive fast, high-quality support, and most issues are resolved without involving Solution Engineering.
* Every customer's AI agent runs on the latest product version.
* Sales and Solution Engineering spend their time on new and strategic accounts rather than ongoing support for existing ones.
* Each account has a weekly review with clear improvement actions and documented upsell opportunities.
* Customer satisfaction and retention stay high, and existing accounts grow through upsells.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* **Base Salary:** $100,000 - $130,000 annually
* **Variable Compensation:** May be eligible for performance-based incentives, such as a bonus or commission, in accordance with the company's applicable plans.
* **Equity:** Stock options may be offered as part of the total compensation package.
* **Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and other company-sponsored benefits.

Compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, role responsibilities, and internal equity.

jobs.title: Customer Account Manager – Sales & Growth
jobs.description:
**Customer Account Manager – Sales & Growth**

**ManageCasa | San Francisco, CA | Full-Time | In-Office**

**Build Relationships. Grow Accounts. Build Your Career.**
----------------------------------------------------------

Are you a people person with a sales mindset who enjoys talking to customers, building relationships, and finding opportunities to grow business?

ManageCasa is looking for an energetic, organized, and confident **Customer Account Manager** to join our growing team in San Francisco.

This is more than a customer service role. It's an opportunity for someone who understands sales, enjoys working directly with clients, and knows how to turn customer relationships into business growth.

You will work closely with our Sales team to manage existing customer accounts, identify upselling opportunities, introduce new features and services, and help our customers get more value from ManageCasa.

**This is also a great opportunity to grow into a senior account management or management leadership role as the company expands.**

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* **Manage Customer Accounts:** Build strong relationships with existing customers and become their trusted point of contact.
* **Drive Upselling:** Identify opportunities to sell additional units, features, services, and software upgrades.
* **Talk to Customers:** Proactively reach out, schedule calls, conduct product discussions, and understand customer needs.
* **Grow Revenue:** Identify opportunities to expand accounts, increase customer value, and support renewals.
* **Work with Sales:** Partner closely with the Sales team to develop opportunities, follow up on leads, and close upsell deals.
* **Customer Success:** Help customers understand ManageCasa and get the most value from the platform.
* **Stay Organized:** Track customer communications, account activity, opportunities, and follow-ups in HubSpot.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **Minimum of 3 years of experience in account management**, preferably in SaaS, technology, or a related industry.
* **College degree required**, preferably in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
* Proven experience in sales, account management, customer success, or business development.
* SaaS sales or account management experience is required.
* Confident communicator who is comfortable picking up the phone and speaking directly with customers.

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.

SHARE provides human resources and academic personnel support services to the College of Chemistry, College of Letters and Sciences Divisions of Social Sciences, Arts & Humanities, and Undergraduate Studies, Space Sciences Laboratory and related Organized Research Units within the University of California, Berkeley.

The position manages appointments end to end for student appointments, visiting scholars/visiting student researchers, affiliates/volunteers, and ASE/GSRs, and applies professional human resources, organization policies and procedures to provide guidance to supervisors and managers to resolve a variety of human resources issues of moderate scope and complexity.

Monitors appointment end date reports and partners with the department to resolve. Monitors Smartsheets for Student Assistant and ASE/GSR appointments.
  
  
Cross-Functional Partnership - 20%
  
  
Onboarding, Payroll, HRIM, Visa, Graduate Division, ELR, APO, and other relevant groups. Manages sensitive and confidential information effectively and works in partnership with client groups to keep them abreast of the progress of their requests.

Provide guidance to supervisors and managers in developing student job descriptions, facilitating benefits communications, and providing guidance on new personnel policies and procedures related to the student assistant, ASE/GSR, and VS/VSR populations. Provide guidance to managers and GSAOs on policies and procedures for the ASE/GSR populations based on their labor contracts. HR Trends Analysis - 5%

Has a working knowledge of HR functional areas, including HR Policy, HCM data entry, benefits, recruitment, and payroll.
  
Ability to maintain confidentiality.
  
Demonstrated analytical skills to conduct analysis and develop recommendations.
  
Excellent listening and customer service skills.

Demonstrated ability to handle difficult or volatile situations/individuals effectively.
